title: Mama J’s Cabin & Powder Horn Campground

services.name: RV Campsites
services.desc: If you’re traveling the country in an RV and need a place to spend some time while you’re passing through Tennessee, Powder Horn Campground welcomes you! We have 30 campsites with full RV hookups in Lawrenceburg, TN, for electric, water and sewer, each with a spacious layout and all of the privacy you’re looking for.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Our campsites are secure and quiet, perfect for travelers who want to rest and relax on their journey. We’ve also got a few much-needed amenities for weary drivers, including an on-site bath house and laundry room.
